title: Sylvain
description: "l was most struck by the transformations of Darth Vader throughout STAR WARS," observes Sylvain. "Anakin Skywalker etnbodies the triumph of man over machine -—- a great modern myth." Born in Antony, France, Sylvain (full name: Sylvain Despretz) moved to the U.S. at age 16. He trained under Neal Adams in the early '80s and went on to work as a concept artist on many film productions. He has also worked in comics in France with Alexandro Jodorowsky and more recently started FOUNTAIN OF YOUTH written by mentor Moebius, with whom he's worked for the last four years. Sylvain's color work has appeared in CADILLACS AND DINOSAURS from Topps.
